With no suite arms there are no failure ids to diff, so added_failure_count is 0 by absence of arms rather than by a measured delta.
call_sites_note: The change adds a docs/evidence fragment, its JSON and a standalone run script under docs/; a grep over imas_codex/, tests/, agents/ and pyproject.toml finds no reference to sib-separatrix-locus-census, so there is no production call site to check. For the reuse judgement the nearest owned code read was imas_codex/standard_names/coverage.py:363 (separatrix_pair_gaps), which owns species pair-gap reporting rather than a locus-to-suffix mapping, and imas_codex/standard_names/advisory_benchmark.py:125, which owns the atomic record publish the fragment re-implements locally.

findings.disposition_hint: fold into a shared atomic-publish helper used by the evidence fragments
findings.text: write_atomic uses a fixed '<name>.partial' sibling path and never fsyncs before Path.replace, duplicating the atomic publish already owned by imas_codex/standard_names/advisory_benchmark.py:125 (publish_atomic) and imas_codex/standard_names/benchmark.py:243 (save_atomic) without extending either. Two concurrent runs would write the same temp path and can rename a partially overwritten file, and a machine crash can leave a renamed record whose bytes are not on disk; the demonstrated guarantee covers only a process interruption of a single run (negative-control.log arms 5-6).

VERDICT goal: the goal is a census of every live name tied to the separatrix or plasma-boundary loci with one suffix per DD locus; sib-separatrix-locus-census.json carries 98 live rows across seven loci with locus, unit, DD paths, chain, tombstones and one action each, plus suffix_by_locus and the tritium block, and both prior blocking defects are repaired.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when forbids a proposed action that targets a superseded tombstone; reading all 98 rows against the 105 recorded tombstones finds zero such targets, cross_check.in_graph_not_in_census and .json list both empty against a set-difference check, and census-gate.log ends EXIT=0.
VERDICT write_paths: the declared paths are the .py, .html and .json fragments plus an unused figures directory; git diff 03bb7cfff..3366d5134 touches exactly the three files and nothing else.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records the eight commits, the gate script invocation, census-gate.log and negative-control.log, and its headline counts (203/98/105, keep 25, signed_rename 72, supersede 1, 5 blocked) match the JSON exactly; its tests line carries env prefixes the log's own command header omits.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit from 03bb7cfff to 3366d5134: an independent id-set cross-check, a keep-with-blocked_spelling rule for taken targets, atomic publish, per-loop tombstone locators, dead-binding removal, a format-only sweep, and two republished records whose sha256 match the gate log.

FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-separatrix-locus-census-run.py:165 non-blocking: write_atomic uses a fixed '<name>.partial' sibling and no fsync, duplicating imas_codex/standard_names/advisory_benchmark.py:125 publish_atomic without extending it; two concurrent runs share one temp path and a machine crash can leave a renamed-but-unsynced record, so the durability guarantee holds only for a process interruption of a single run.
